Game Overview

Dungeon Dodge puts players into a arcade experience centered on brave the magical onslaught in Dungeon Dodge, where quick reflexes and deft maneuvers are your only allies. As an agile hero, dodge fireballs to gather riches, aid your village, and unlock new heroes. Master the art of evasion, and transform risks into glory in this thrilling arcade adventure.
